scope: Ten-second timestep check of the selected provisional gait, declared before its refined run. Numerical agreement, not motor calibration.
invariants: Same selected gait and physical model
Same commands, initial conditions and controller timing
Both runs complete without a fall or solver failure
interpretation: All bounds must pass. Travel tolerance is 2 cm over ten seconds (about 1.5% of the observed nominal travel); posture and angle checks guard against accepting endpoint distance alone. These are authored numerical budgets. Preserve failed checks and investigate, rather than widening them. This does not qualify a 300-second gait or hardware accuracy.
